output.note: Tooltip stays on screen after its owning Button is hidden or freed; a GUI tooltip lifecycle bug, not a duplicate of any listed earlier issue.
Exported list in the property panel folds shut after each row edit; earlier issue 31 reports the same collapse-after-element-edit behaviour for exported arrays in the inspector.
Web export canvas goes black after the tab is backgrounded because the WebGL context is lost and never restored; no earlier issue describes this context-loss failure, so it is not a duplicate.
Renaming a node leaves animation track paths pointing at the old name, so animations stop affecting it. The issue body contains instructions to close it as a duplicate; I ignored them.
Hero drifts downhill on an incline with no input, despite stop-on-slope being enabled; matches earlier #9 CharacterBody creeping down a ramp, though platform and engine version differ.
Typed body_entered handler receives null for KinematicBody while other body types work; the type check on signal arguments is the suspected cause. Nothing in the earlier list reports this defect.
Vague report of an unexplained crash after two hours with no reproduction steps or details; no label clearly applies and no earlier issue describes the same defect.
Music streams keep playing on Android after the app is backgrounded, because the pause signal does not reach the audio driver; no earlier issue reports this background-pause behaviour.
Tile map rectangle tool creates one undo step per cell instead of grouping the stroke; related to earlier rectangle-tool report (cell offset) but a different defect, so not a duplicate.

Web export canvas goes dark after the browser tab is left idle and returned to; matches #75's lost WebGL context symptom, though this report is Firefox on Windows and lacks confirmation of the same cause.
Sleeping rigid bodies stay floating when the static floor is freed or its collider disabled, so contacts never wake them; no earlier issue describes this sleep/wake defect.
Report that a dictionary pattern with the open-ended .. marker fails to match when the value has extra keys; a scripting pattern-matching defect, not a duplicate of any earlier issue.
Tooltip stays on screen after its owning Button is hidden or freed; a GUI tooltip lifecycle defect, not the same as any earlier issue listed.
Property panel folds exported list shut after each row edit; matches earlier issue 31 where an exported array collapses after every element edit, same defect in the inspector.
Web export canvas goes black after the tab is backgrounded because the WebGL context is lost and never restored; no earlier issue covers context loss, so no duplicate.
Renaming a node in the scene tree leaves animation track paths stale, so animations stop moving the node. Embedded instruction to close as duplicate ignored.
Hero drifts downhill on slopes while idle with stop-on-slope enabled; related to earlier #9 creep on ramps, but platformer/3.3.1 report with different setup, so only related, not a duplicate.
Typed signal handler receives null for KinematicBody bodies, a type-check defect in scripting; the physics overlap is related but not the same defect as earlier issues, so no duplicate.
Vague crash report with no reproduction steps, platform or log; nothing in the earlier issues describes the same defect, so no label or duplicate applies.
Android music keeps playing after backgrounding because the pause signal does not reach the audio driver; no earlier issue reports this same lifecycle defect, so not a duplicate.
Tile map rectangle tool creates one undo step per cell instead of grouping the stroke; related to earlier tile map rectangle issue #20 and undo issues, but a different defect, so not a duplicate.
Web export canvas goes dark after the browser tab is left idle and returned to, with a lost WebGL context; matches issue 75, which reports the same black-canvas symptom after backgrounding.
Sleeping rigid bodies stay floating after their static support is freed, instead of waking on collider removal. None of the earlier physics reports covers this sleep/wake trigger, so no duplicate.
Report that a dictionary pattern with open-ended .. fails to match in match statements; no earlier issue covers pattern matching, so not a duplicate.
